title: Inspect HLO Dumps
description: Inspect HLO/LLO compilation dumps (local directory, GCS URI, or pod path), extract collective channel IDs and custom calls, and detect cross-worker HLO module or fingerprint mismatches.

dump_source.description: Local directory path, gs:// URI, or pod:<namespace>/<pod>:/tmp/xla_dump containing HLO dump files.

bucket_location.description: Optional GCS bucket location (gs://path) alias for dump_source.

xplane_path.description: Optional path to .xplane.pb file or directory for embedded HloProto module inspection.
